top_choice_rationale: P003 names a precise prediction (the 2011 continuum model with a flat band at a magic angle) and the experiment that found the correlated insulating and superconducting states it made plausible, reproduced by many groups and now a tunable platform for strongly correlated electrons. The allocation of MacDonald, Bistritzer and Jarillo-Herrero is the two authors of the prediction plus the experimental leader, and the citation avoids the unsettled pairing mechanism. Maturity (about eight years) is the real weakness, and I rank P001 next, since its 2D prediction-plus-HgTe citation has two decades of confirmation but omits Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang; P002 has the cleanest credit but is closer to an instrument advance and overlaps neighbouring metrology prizes; no award is last because each of the three has a defensible scientific case.
